dedupe_rule: replay each fingerprint at most once after exact readback confirms Make capacity is executable
completion_rule: No error is PROVEN learning without rootCause, failedApproach, fix, preventionRule, regressionContract and outcomeEvidence.

errors.error: BlueprintValidationError before module execution after parallel fanout router was added.
errors.rootCause: The parallel router topology was not accepted as a valid runnable blueprint in the composed BG211 scenario.
errors.failedApproach: Assuming save-time acceptance plus generic mapper warnings meant the multi-route fanout blueprint was executable.
errors.fix: Isolate the core path, prove normalize->dedupe->Datahub first, then replace parallel fanout with a mutually exclusive fail-closed decision tree.
errors.regressionContract: BG211 core T1 canary succeeds; material T3 canary reaches BG205 and BG168; duplicate replay COALESCES before downstream fanout.

errors.error: Create/patch warnings claimed url/scenario parameters were missing while exact saved module readback showed valid mapper fields and connections.
errors.rootCause: Make create-time warning paths can diverge from authoritative module_spec and saved blueprint representation.
errors.failedApproach: Blindly rewriting mapper fields into parameters based on warning text alone.
errors.fix: Compare warning path to module_spec and exact scenario_module_get readback; only runtime-test after structural readback is consistent.
errors.regressionContract: Saved module mapping equals working reference modules and bounded runtime canary succeeds.
errors.outcomeEvidence: BG211 mappings read back correctly and core/T3 canaries executed successfully.

errors.error: Organization/team paused because operations or data-transfer capacity was exceeded.
errors.rootCause: External paid Make capacity was unavailable during runtime verification.
errors.failedApproach: Retrying paid executions while the team is paused would burn time/credits and cannot resolve the platform boundary.
errors.fix: Stop retries, continue independent GitHub/schema work, preserve exact dedupeable runtime-proof obligations and resume only after fresh capacity evidence.
errors.regressionContract: Read current Make capacity/state before any resume run; execute exactly one bounded canary after recovery.
errors.outcomeEvidence: Runtime attempts were stopped after the capacity error; independent GitHub work continued without additional Make runs.

errors.error: BRAIN delivery run 33516203498 failed because tests/event-retention-expiry.test.mjs was unclassified.
errors.rootCause: The new event-retention test family was added without a generic prefix classification in config/brain-delivery-system.json.
errors.failedApproach: Registering only specific filenames or older test prefixes creates recurring delivery-classifier gaps.
errors.fix: Classify tools/tests event-retention and universal-failure families by prefix in both conflict contract and backend lane.
errors.regressionContract: Any new tests/event-retention-*.test.mjs and tests/universal-failure-*.test.mjs must be classified automatically and executed by the dedicated workflow.
errors.outcomeEvidence: GitHub job 99883770993 log: unclassified delivery path; classifier subsequently broadened by prefix.

errors.error: A workflow could report green while a newly added regression file was not included in its explicit node --test command.
errors.rootCause: Workflow trigger paths and test execution enumeration evolved independently.
errors.failedApproach: Treating workflow-trigger success as proof every changed regression test actually executed.
errors.fix: Co-change trigger family and test command; use family prefixes for classification and explicitly execute required contract files.
errors.regressionContract: Dedicated workflow paths include universal-event, universal-failure and event-retention families and node --test includes their contract suites.
errors.outcomeEvidence: The workflow was updated after detecting the false-green risk; universal-failure is now an explicit executed suite.

errors.error: A green configuration/check or merge acknowledgement can be mistaken for a successful deployed production outcome.
errors.rootCause: Repository mutation, CI status, Netlify deploy state and exact production commit identity are separate evidence layers.
errors.failedApproach: Declaring completion from PR merge, command/instruction response, deploy acknowledgement or a non-exact production state.
errors.fix: Require exact tested head, current-main readback after merge, Netlify current deploy readback with exact commit_ref, smoke/regression/security checks and durable outcome evidence before PRODUCTION_GREEN.
errors.regressionContract: candidate SHA == merged/main SHA == Netlify commit_ref; required CI and production smoke are green on that identity.
errors.outcomeEvidence: Existing BRAIN preflight lessons already enforce exact deploy identity, Netlify execution proof and main/production parity; this bundle makes the rule universal for all future delivery.
